bundle: CanDoItAll.Components WebGL Symbolic Tycoon Sandbox Workflow Bundle
primary_goal: Extend the generic WebGL component wrapper with domain-neutral scene/assets/symbols/interaction/interop contracts and create an isolated generic WebGL sandbox that renders a small tycoon-like village demo using existing GLB assets.
non_goals: No economy-specific concepts in WebGlLib or WebGlSandbox.
No dependency from the generic WebGL sandbox to processes, economy, or main CanDoItAll app modules.
No breaking changes to existing WebGlWorkbench until compatibility proof is in place.
expected_outputs: Domain-neutral WebGlLib scene contracts and services.
Generic status-symbol support suitable for tycoon-style visualizations.
Small village demo scene with GLB asset catalog usage.
Build, asset, and browser-proof validation notes.
